title: Cooking terms and what they mean

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia
source.method: enwiki: Braising, Sautéing, Julienning, Roux, Deglazing (cooking), Sous vide, Mise en place, Al dente and the other term articles, one per row

meaning.pick: In the kitchen, which of these describes {label}?
meaning.match: Match each cooking term to what it means.

rows.label: Sous vide
rows.meaning: Cook sealed in a bag in a precisely heated water bath

rows.label: Mise en place
rows.meaning: Having everything prepped and set out before cooking starts

rows.label: Roux
rows.meaning: Flour and fat cooked together to thicken a sauce

rows.label: Pickle
rows.meaning: Preserve food in vinegar or salty water

rows.label: Bain-marie
rows.meaning: A pan of hot water that heats a dish gently

rows.label: Cure
rows.meaning: Preserve and flavour meat or fish with salt

rows.label: Confit
rows.meaning: Cook slowly in fat so the food keeps

rows.label: Braise
rows.meaning: Brown first, then cook slowly in a covered pot with a little liquid

rows.label: Gratin
rows.meaning: A dish finished with a browned crust of cheese or crumbs

rows.label: Al dente
rows.meaning: Cooked so pasta stays pleasantly firm to the bite

rows.label: Deep fry
rows.meaning: Cook completely submerged in hot oil

rows.label: Sauté
rows.meaning: Cook quickly in a little fat in a hot pan, keeping the food moving

rows.label: Grill
rows.meaning: Cook with direct heat on the surface of the food

rows.label: Blanch
rows.meaning: Dip briefly in boiling water, then chill fast in ice water

rows.label: Stir-fry
rows.meaning: Cook small pieces in a hot wok with little oil, tossing constantly

rows.label: Caramelize
rows.meaning: Heat sugar until it turns brown, sweet and nutty

rows.label: Julienne
rows.meaning: Cut into long thin matchstick strips

rows.label: Flambé
rows.meaning: Add alcohol to a hot pan so it bursts into flame

rows.label: Parboil
rows.meaning: Cook partway in bubbling water as a first step

rows.label: Poach
rows.meaning: Cook gently in hot liquid that is barely moving

rows.label: Roast
rows.meaning: Cook with dry oven heat surrounding the food on all sides

rows.label: Proof
rows.meaning: Let shaped yeast dough rest and rise before it goes in the oven

rows.label: Baste
rows.meaning: Spoon juices or sauce over food while it cooks

rows.label: Whisk
rows.meaning: Beat briskly with wire loops to blend or add air

rows.label: Brine
rows.meaning: Soak in salty water so the food seasons through and stays moist

rows.label: Simmer
rows.meaning: Cook in liquid held just under the point where it bubbles hard

rows.label: Marinate
rows.meaning: Soak food in a seasoned liquid before cooking

rows.label: Steam
rows.meaning: Cook with the hot vapour rising from boiling water

rows.label: Sear
rows.meaning: Brown the outside fast at very high heat

rows.label: Zest
rows.meaning: The grated colourful outer peel of a citrus fruit

rows.label: Deglaze
rows.meaning: Pour liquid into a pan to lift the browned bits stuck to it

rows.label: Knead
rows.meaning: Work dough by pressing and folding it to build stretch

rows.label: Reduce
rows.meaning: Boil a liquid down so it thickens and tastes stronger
